title: Collective decisions under uncertainty: efficiency, ex-ante fairness, and normalization
abstract: arXiv:2505.03232v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper studies preference aggregation under uncertainty in the multi-profile framework and characterizes a new class of aggregation rules that can address classical concerns about Harsanyi's (1995) utilitarian rules. Our aggregation rules, which we call \textit{relative fair aggregation rules}, are grounded in three key ideas: utilitarianism, egalitarianism, and the 0--1 normalization of individual utilities. These rules are parameterized by a set of weight vectors over individuals and evaluate each ambiguous alternative by taking the minimum weighted sum of 0--1 normalized utility levels over the weight set. For the characterization, we propose two novel axioms, \textit{weak preference for mixing} and \textit{restricted certainty independence}, with normative justifications. Additional results clarify how these axioms capture the utilitarian and egalitarian attitudes of the rules.

translated_title: 不确定性下的集体决策：效率、事前公平与归一化
translated_abstract: 本文在多主体框架下研究不确定性环境中的偏好聚合问题，并刻画了一类能够回应Harsanyi（1995）功利主义规则经典关切的新型聚合规则。我们将这类规则称为“相对公平聚合规则”，其建立在三个核心思想之上：功利主义、平等主义以及个体效用的0–1归一化。这些规则由一组作用于个体的权重向量参数化，并通过在权重集合上取0–1归一化效用水平的加权总和的最小值来评估每个模糊备选方案。为完成公理化刻画，我们提出了两个新颖的公理——“对混合的弱偏好”和“受限确定性独立”，并给出了其规范性论证。其他结果进一步阐明了这些公理如何体现规则的功利主义与平等主义态度。
tldr: 本文提出了一类融合功利主义、平等主义与0–1效用归一化的“相对公平聚合规则”，并通过“对混合的弱偏好”与“受限确定性独立”两个新公理对其加以公理化刻画，从而回应了Harsanyi功利主义规则在不确定性集体决策中的经典公平性关切。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a new class of "relative fair aggregation rules" grounded in utilitarianism, egalitarianism, and 0–1 utility normalization, and axiomatizes them through two novel axioms—weak preference for mixing and restricted certainty independence—thereby addressing classical fairness concerns about Harsanyi's utilitarian rules in collective decisions under uncertainty.
